description: Set-up files (ADR-088, docs/set-up-file.md), each with what a reader makes of it. file is the file's text, or file_hex its bytes in hexadecimal where they are not UTF-8 or where any string in the file, a value or a member's name, is in a spelling only a secret has (secret_shaped), so that no such string is held in these vectors as text. A file is refused whole for the reason in refused, or read: contents is the digest of its canonical contents (the file without its seal, in RFC 8785 canonical JSON, as Blake3-256 in CESR qb64), flags what the person is told of the file's own notes, and each item is ready, blocked (blocks: the reasons, each once, sorted) or not_understood, with its flags, its rest digest, the utility apps it names, those of them that are utility-app items of the file (depends_on) and the credentials it needs. seal is what the seal is found to be by a reader that holds, for each identity in keys, a key log of one event, at 0, whose key is in force (earlier_keys names those whose key has since been rotated away from; no_key_log is a reader that holds none); sealed_by is whose signature verified, and seal_input the bytes signed. approvals are choices made from those files: bytes is the chosen list an approval signs (in RFC 8785 canonical JSON) and digest its digest, or refused says why the choice gives no list. lists are the bytes of a chosen list as a device is handed them, read or refused. Keys are Ed25519, each from a published seed; an identifier is the key in CESR qb64 under the code D. Signatures are CESR indexed signatures (code A, index 0). The reader of these vectors knows the kind website and the example kinds and extension described in example_kinds, and nothing else. The Unicode facts text is judged by are in unicode-15.0.json, beside this file.
example_kinds: Three things are made up for these vectors, and none is shipped. example.worker is a kind. Its own members, all optional, are "note" (text of at most 200 bytes, declared as prose, so text shaped like an identifier there is flagged and does not block), "title" (text of at most 200 bytes, not prose), "credential" (the name of a credential it needs, which the file's credentials_needed must name) and "reports_to" (the name of a utility app, which the kind declares its field names); any other member is one it does not know. example.utility_app is a kind whose items are utility apps, which a permission on a utility app may name. Its one own member, optional, is "note" (text of at most 200 bytes, prose). example.labels is an extension: an object with exactly one member, "label", one lower-case word ([a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}). Each declares its member names, so a finding may say them.
